description: Bitcoin mainnet winning nonces with full 76-byte header prefixes for 500 consecutive blocks, heights 975565-976064 (chain-verified)

row_format.prefix_hex: 76-byte header prefix, internal wire order: version_le || prevhash_internal || merkle_internal || ntime_le || nbits_le
row_format.nonce: winning nonce, packed little-endian after prefix to form the 80-byte header
row_format.chain_hash: block hash in display order; equals reverse(sha256d(header))
